decision.explanation: The source documents present two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding the spouse of Abdul Salihin Yusuf. Document 1 (D1S5) explicitly states he is married to 'Frieda Callebaut', citing multiple sources including The Jakarta Post and a Ministry of Defense biography. Document 2 (D2S2) explicitly states he married 'Marta Eggerth', citing 'sources close to the family'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all audits as fallible without inventing authority to resolve the contradiction, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the provided text.
